Alright, let me think through this year on my 5 mu of cotton.

I've been growing cotton on this land for most of my 35 years farming. It's not much land — just 5 mu — but cotton fits us because my wife and I can handle the picking ourselves without hiring help, and the western side of Quzhou is cotton country. My soil is decent but not rich, and after so many years in cotton I know what it needs.

I'll plant around April 20-25, when the soil is warm enough. I buy Bt hybrid seed from the agri-store in town — the extension guy pushes these and honestly the bollworm problem got much better since we switched years ago. Costs about 90 yuan per mu for seed but worth it. I use plastic mulch too, keeps the soil warm early and cuts down on weeds.

For fertilizer, I put down a bag of compound (15-15-15) before planting as base — that's about 40 kg per mu, gives roughly 6 kg each of N, P, K. Then at flowering stage I topdress urea, maybe 15-17 kg per mu. That's another 7-8 kg N. Extension guy said 13-14 kg N total is enough but I always go a bit more because I saw my neighbor skimp on fertilizer two years ago and his bolls were small. Better to spend the extra 50 yuan than lose yield.

Irrigation twice usually — once before planting to settle the soil if spring is dry (April was dry this year, so yes), and once at peak flowering/early boll in July. Well water isn't free, electric pump costs add up, so I don't irrigate more than I have to. If August rains come I skip the third one.

Pesticide — Bt handles bollworms mostly, but I still spray 3-4 times for aphids and spider mites, and maybe once for cotton blight. Herbicide once after planting before mulch goes down.

Picking starts late August and runs through October, three or four passes. Just me and my wife, maybe 50 person-days total across the season. Kids are grown and working in Handan, they don't help anymore.

I'm expecting around 260 kg lint per mu if the weather cooperates. Last year I got 240, year before 270. Prices have been okay, around 7-8 yuan/kg for seed cotton.
